# <zbk-link>

The zebkit link: a light-DOM element wrapping a real `<a>`. Forwards native
anchor semantics, adopts authored content into a token-driven skeleton, and
can borrow button's style contract via `appearance="button"` without ever
becoming a button. No custom events — clicks bubble natively.

Base class: `.zbk-link`. Variant classes: `.zbk-link--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-link-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- Activating the control takes the user somewhere: another page, a fragment, a downloadable file.
- A navigational call-to-action needs button emphasis — appearance="button" paints it as a button while keeping link semantics.
- NOT Activation mutates state rather than navigating: submit, confirm, dismiss, open a panel. → zbk-button
- NOT The destination should be unavailable right now. → Remove the href. Links cannot be disabled — there is no accessible equivalent.

## Guidance

- Link navigates, button acts. A <button> whose handler sets location.href is the bug this component exists to prevent — it loses open-in-new-tab, copy-address, and the links rotor.
- appearance="button" changes paint only. The role stays "link", because the interaction contract the user actually gets (Enter not Space, modified-click, new tab) is an anchor's.
- Under appearance="button", `variant` resolves against button's registry — shipped variants (ghost, outline, subtle, sm, lg) and any variant a consumer compiled into their theme. Link's own `subtle` is unreachable there; both registries happen to contain that name and they mean different things.
- Underlines live on the label, not the anchor, so a slotted icon never sits under the rule.
- There is no external attribute. "External" is two unrelated facts: being cross-origin decides only whether to default target, and opening a new tab is what drives the rel hardening, the hint, and the icon. HTML already spells both — target="_blank" forces a new tab, target="_self" opts out of detection, omitting target lets the config decide.
- Write target="_blank" and zebkit makes it safe and legible: rel="noopener" is appended to whatever rel you wrote, a visually-hidden "(opens in a new tab)" hint joins the accessible name, and an indicator is drawn. You do not hand-write any of that, and you cannot turn the hint off.
- aria-label and aria-labelledby replace a link's content, and the new-tab hint lives in that content — so on an ARIA-named new-tab link, include the hint in the label text yourself. Dev mode warns.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | — | Destination. Without it the anchor is a placeholder: not focusable, not announced as a link. |
| `target` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native. Pair `_blank` with rel="noopener" — dev mode warns otherwise. |
| `rel` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native relationship tokens, forwarded verbatim. |
| `download` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native: download the destination instead of navigating to it. |
| `hreflang` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native: language of the destination. |
| `type` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native: MIME type hint for the destination. |
| `appearance` | `ZbkLinkAppearance` | `"link"` | Which component's compiled style contract the anchor wears. `"button"` paints the link as a button and switches `variant` to button's vocabulary; semantics stay a link's either way. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | The link text (its accessible name). | required |
| `icon` | A supplementary pictogram rendered aria-hidden beside the label — any markup: svg, icon-font glyph, HTML character, image. | aria-hidden; sized by `icon-size`; data-position: start\\|end |

- `default`: Icon-only links must supply the accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby; dev mode warns when the computed name is empty.
- `default`: Write link text that describes the destination. "Read more" repeated down a page is useless in a links-list rotor.
- `icon`: Use data-position="start|end" for explicit placement; when omitted, placement is inferred from authored child order.
- `icon`: Icons inherit the label's ink (currentColor); there is no separate icon color token.
- `icon`: On hover each icon nudges away from the label via icon-transform-hover-start / -end.

## Keyboard

- `Enter` — Follows the link (native behavior, preserved). Unlike a button, Space does not activate a link — this stays true under appearance="button".

## Options (behavior)

Named, defaulted decisions about what this component conveniently *does*, set under `components.link.options` in zebkit.config.json and carried into the browser by the generated runtime config module. `false` is the off switch for any of them. Precedence is one chain with no exceptions: **instance attribute > project config > zebkit default** — whatever the config decided, the markup outranks it.

| Option | Type | Default | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addRelNoopener` | `boolean` | `true` | Appends noopener to the rel of any target="_blank" link that lacks noopener or noreferrer, never replacing what the author wrote. |
| `internalHosts` | `string[]` | `[]` | Hosts openExternalInNewTab treats as internal in addition to the current origin, e.g. docs.example.com. |
| `newTabHint` | `string` | `"(opens in a new tab)"` | The visually-hidden text appended to a new-tab link's accessible name; rewordable for localization, never removable. |
| `newTabIcon` | `object` | `{"text":"↗"}` | The affordance drawn on a new-tab link: { text } compiles into a CSS token, { classes } / { src } / { html } render a real element, and false turns it off. |
| `openExternalInNewTab` | `boolean` | `false` | Gives a cross-origin link with no authored target a target of _blank; off by default because an unrequested context change is felt rather than read. |

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Basic**

```html
<zbk-link href="/pricing">See pricing</zbk-link>
```

**With a trailing icon**

```html
<zbk-link href="/docs">Read the docs<svg slot="icon" data-position="end" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></zbk-link>
```

**Subtle: no underline until hover**

```html
<zbk-link href="/changelog" variant="subtle">Changelog</zbk-link>
```

For dense navigation where a page of underlined text becomes unreadable; the underline returns on hover so the affordance is never color-only.

**Navigational call-to-action wearing button paint**

```html
<zbk-link href="/signup" appearance="button" variant="outline lg">Get started</zbk-link>
```

Borrows button's compiled contract (GRAMMAR.md §6) so the CTA matches the theme's buttons exactly, while staying a real link.

**Current page**

```html
<zbk-link href="/pricing" aria-current="page">Pricing</zbk-link>
```

aria-current relocates to the anchor and drives the -current ink token.

**Opens in a new tab**

```html
<zbk-link href="https://example.com" target="_blank">Example</zbk-link>
```

target="_blank" is the whole authoring surface. rel="noopener", the visually-hidden "(opens in a new tab)" hint, and the indicator are added for you — hand-writing them is the boilerplate this replaces.

**Same tab, deliberately**

```html
<zbk-link href="https://example.com" target="_self">Example</zbk-link>
```

Opts a cross-origin link out of openExternalInNewTab. target="_self" is valid HTML naming the current browsing context, which is why there is no external attribute to spell this a second way.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-link-ink` | `{action.ink}` | color | — | Default link text color. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-hover` | `{action.ink-emphasis}` | color | — | Link text color when hovered. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-active` | `{action.ink-emphasis}` | color | — | Link text color while being activated. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-focus` | `{link.ink}` | color | — | Link text color while the link has keyboard focus. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-visited` | `{action.ink-muted}` | color | — | Link text color once the destination has been visited. Defaults to the resting ink — a distinct visited color is valuable for reference content and noisy for app navigation, so it is opt-in. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-visited-hover` | `{link.ink-visited}` | color | — | Text color of a visited link when hovered. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-visited-active` | `{link.ink-visited}` | color | — | Text color of a visited link while being activated. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-visited-focus` | `{link.ink-focus}` | color | — | Text color of a visited link with keyboard focus. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-current` | `{app.ink}` | color | — | Link text color when the link points at the current page (aria-current). Reads as body text because the destination is where the reader already is. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-current-hover` | `{link.ink-current}` | color | — | Text color of a current-destination link when hovered. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-current-active` | `{link.ink-current}` | color | — | Text color of a current-destination link while being activated. |
| `--zbk-link-ink-current-focus` | `{link.ink-current}` | color | — | Text color of a current-destination link with keyboard focus. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-line` | `underline` | textDecoration | — | Underline treatment at rest. Underlines are the non-color affordance that makes a link identifiable without relying on hue (WCAG 1.4.1). |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-line-hover` | `{link.decoration-line}` | textDecoration | — | Underline treatment on hover. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-style` | `dotted` | textDecoration | — | Underline style at rest (solid, dotted, dashed, wavy). Dotted reads as a softer, more editorial link. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-style-hover` | `{link.decoration-style}` | textDecoration | — | Underline style on hover. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-color` | `{action.ink-muted}` | color | — | Underline color at rest. Muted against the text so the underline sits behind the word rather than competing with it. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-color-hover` | `{action.ink}` | color | — | Underline color on hover. Strengthening the rule is the cheapest possible hover signal — no layout moves. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-color-visited` | `{link.decoration-color}` | color | — | Underline color for visited links. One of only two properties browsers allow :visited to change (the other is color). |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-color-visited-hover` | `{link.decoration-color-visited}` | color | — | Underline color of a visited link when hovered. Kept separate because browsers permit visited styling only for color properties. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-thickness` | `{spacing.2xs}` | dimension | — | Underline thickness at rest. |
| `--zbk-link-decoration-thickness-hover` | `{link.decoration-thickness}` | dimension | — | Underline thickness on hover. |
| `--zbk-link-underline-offset` | `{spacing.xs}` | dimension | — | Distance from the text baseline to the underline. Offsetting keeps the rule clear of descenders, which is what makes an underlined link legible. |
| `--zbk-link-underline-offset-hover` | `{spacing.sm}` | dimension | — | Underline offset on hover. Growing the offset drops the rule away from the word — motion the reader feels without anything reflowing. |
| `--zbk-link-font-family` | `inherit` | cssFontFamily | — | Font family for link text. Inherits so an inline link matches the prose around it. |
| `--zbk-link-font-size` | `inherit` | cssDimension | — | Font size for link text. Inherits so an inline link matches the prose around it. |
| `--zbk-link-font-weight` | `inherit` | cssFontWeight | — | Font weight for link text. |
| `--zbk-link-line-height` | `inherit` | cssNumber | — | Line height for link text. Inheriting keeps a wrapped inline link on the paragraph's own rhythm. |
| `--zbk-link-letter-spacing` | `inherit` | cssDimension | — | Letter spacing for link text. |
| `--zbk-link-text-box-trim` | `none` | textBoxTrim | — | Which half-leading edges to trim off the link's text box. Untrimmed by default: trimming a link inside a paragraph misaligns it against the surrounding line box. Set `trim-both` for standalone links. |
| `--zbk-link-text-box-edge` | `auto` | textBoxEdge | — | The font metrics text-box-trim trims to, e.g. `cap alphabetic`. Only takes effect where text-box-trim is set and the browser supports it. |
| `--zbk-link-display` | `inline` | display | — | Display mode for a text-only link. Deliberately `inline`, not `inline-flex`: an inline-flex link cannot break across lines, which breaks reflow mid-sentence (WCAG 1.4.10). |
| `--zbk-link-display-with-icon` | `inline-flex` | display | — | Display mode once the link carries an icon. A link with an icon is a discrete object rather than a run of words, so flex layout is safe there. |
| `--zbk-link-align-items` | `center` | flex | — | Cross-axis alignment of label and icon when the link is flex. |
| `--zbk-link-icon-gap` | `{spacing.xs}` | dimension | — | Gap between the link label and its icon. |
| `--zbk-link-icon-size` | `{spacing.md}` | cssDimension | — | Icon size within links. Relative to the link's own font size so the icon tracks the text it accompanies. |
| `--zbk-link-icon-transform` | `none` | transform | — | Icon transform at rest. |
| `--zbk-link-icon-transform-hover-start` | `translateX(-0.125em) scale(1.125)` | transform | — | Leading-icon transform on hover. Nudges away from the label (inline-start) so the pair opens outward rather than drifting sideways. |
| `--zbk-link-icon-transform-hover-end` | `translateX(0.125em) scale(1.125)` | transform | — | Trailing-icon transform on hover. Nudges away from the label (inline-end); the mirrored sign is what makes the gesture read as 'onward' rather than 'shift'. |
| `--zbk-link-new-tab-indicator` | `"↗"` | content | — | The affordance drawn after a link that opens a new tab, as `content:` on `[target="_blank"]::after`. CSS rather than script, so it survives a blocked bundle and the pre-upgrade paint. `none` removes it; the `components.link.options.newTabIcon` config compiles into this value. |
| `--zbk-link-cursor` | `pointer` | cursor | — | Cursor style when hovering a link. |
| `--zbk-link-padding-inline` | `0` | cssDimension | — | Inline padding. Zero for inline links so they do not disturb the line; icon-only links raise it to build a tap target. |
| `--zbk-link-padding-block` | `0` | cssDimension | — | Block padding. Zero for inline links; see padding-inline. |
| `--zbk-link-min-inline-size` | `0` | cssDimension | — | Minimum inline size. Zero by default — an inline text link must not be force-grown to a 44px target inside a paragraph. Icon-only links raise this to `{a11y.min-interaction-size}`. |
| `--zbk-link-min-block-size` | `0` | cssDimension | — | Minimum block size. Zero by default; see min-inline-size for the icon-only case. |
| `--zbk-link-border-radius` | `{border.radius-xs}` | dimension | — | Corner radius, which the focus outline follows. |
| `--zbk-link-focus-color` | `{focus.color}` | color | — | Outline color for focus state. |
| `--zbk-link-focus-width` | `{focus.width}` | dimension | — | Outline width for focus state. |
| `--zbk-link-focus-offset` | `{focus.offset}` | dimension | — | Outline offset for focus state. |
| `--zbk-link-transition-duration` | `{transition.playful-fx-duration-default}` | duration | — | Duration for link hover transitions. The fx duration, not the motion one: the slower spatial timing reads as lag on a color change the pointer is sitting on. **(a11y)** |
| `--zbk-link-transition-timing-function` | `{transition.playful-motion-function-default}` | cubicBezier | — | Easing for link hover transitions. The playful motion curve overshoots slightly, which is what gives the icon nudge its spring. |
| `--zbk-link-transition-property` | `color, text-decoration-color, text-decoration-thickness, text-underline-offset, transform` | transitionProperty | — | CSS properties that animate on hover. Enumerated rather than `all` so layout properties never animate and the reduced-motion modifier has a known surface. |
| `--zbk-link-transition-delay` | `0ms` | duration | — | Delay before link hover transitions run. |

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subtle` | style | `zbk-link--subtle` | No underline at rest; underline returns on hover so the affordance is never lost for keyboard and low-vision users. | ink: {app.ink}; ink-hover: {action.ink}; decoration-line: none; decoration-line-hover: underline; decoration-color-hover: {action.ink} |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-link.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "link": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-link--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

What `components.link.options` resolves to here, carried into the browser by the generated runtime config module. An instance attribute always outranks these (GRAMMAR.md §11).

| Option | Value |
|---|---|
| `addRelNoopener` | `true` |
| `internalHosts` | `[]` |
| `newTabHint` | `"(opens in a new tab)"` |
| `newTabIcon` | `{"text":"↗"}` |
